content.text: The Notification System is responsible for providing real-time updates to customers, delivery partners, and merchants. It ensures that all stakeholders are informed of critical events throughout the order lifecycle, from placement to completion.
**Order Status Updates**: The system must send automated notifications for key events:

- Order Confirmation (to Customer)
    - Order Ready for Pickup (to Delivery Partner)
    - Order Picked Up (to Customer)
    - Delivery Arriving Soon (to Customer)
    - Order Delivered (to Customer and Merchant)
**Multi-Channel Support**: Support for WhatsApp (Primary), Push Notifications (Mobile App), SMS (Emergency/Offline), and In-app Message Center.
**Language Support**: All notification content will be provided in English only for the initial release.
**User Preferences**: Users must be able to toggle specific notification types (e.g., promotional vs. transactional).
**Delivery Partner Alerts**: Specific alerts for new available orders based on proximity.
**Ad Notifications**: Ability to send promotional/ad-based notifications to users without requiring "read" status tracking.
**Latency**: Push notifications should be delivered within 5 seconds of the triggering event.
**Reliability**: The system must guarantee at least once delivery for transactional notifications.
**Scalability**: Ability to handle a high volume of concurrent notifications during peak hours (e.g., lunch and dinner).
